posts.text: Американці масово готуються до апокаліпсису — продажі товарів для виживання в мережі Survival Frog з 27 жовтня до 16 листопада злетіли на 450%. На тлі кібератак і регулярних збоїв люди скуповують консерви, акумулятори та фільтри для води. Тренд отримав назву prepping — підготовка до надзвичайних ситуацій із нішевого захоплення перетворилася на мейнстрим. Рух уже дістався Європи, де влада рекомендує громадянам мати запас ресурсів, щоб самостійно протриматися щонайменше 72 години в разі надзвичайної ситуації. 🇺🇦 Реальна Війна | Підписатись

🇱🇾 Ukrainian naval drone attack off Benghazi Explosions and fires occurred near the Libyan coast as enemy forces continued attacks on maritime targets. A commercial vessel was struck by an unmanned sea drone, with its name and affiliation currently unknown. The Libyan National Army (LNA), controlling Benghazi under Khalifa Haftar, intercepted several surface drones using helicopters. The LNA stated it repelled multiple attacks on Russian vessels in the area and destroyed a group of Ukrainian MAGURA unmanned boats. Intelligence suggests the drones may have been launched from a covert Ukrainian base in Libya used for sporadic AFU operations. Notably, a US reconnaissance aircraft, Bombardier ARTEMIS II ISTAR (N159L #A0EC98 ), was detected circling the region shortly before the incident, indicating NATO support for these long-range strikes beyond the Black Sea theatre. @Slavyangrad

🏥 Journalist Omar Toledo Floreano, owner of the newspaper El Observador and the digital channel Toledito TV, remains in critical condition at a hospital in Guayaquil after being shot multiple times on Saturday, November 21, in the coastal province of Santa Elena, Ecuador. 🏍️ According to police reports, two individuals on a motorcycle intercepted and opened fire on the vehicle in which Toledo was traveling at the intersection of Colonche and Manabí streets, where forensic experts collected at least nine pieces of ballistic evidence. ⚖️ After being initially stabilized in intensive care in Santa Elena and transferred to Guayaquil due to the severity of his injuries, the District Attorney’s Office launched an ex officio investigation and ordered a review of the area’s video surveillance footage to determine the motives behind the attack.

🌊 Ecuador’s National Institute of Meteorology and Hydrology (Inamhi) issued a weather alert for heavy rains and thunderstorms, effective through Tuesday, November 24, warning of a high risk of rising river levels and flooding in the Coastal region, the southern Sierra, and the Galápagos Islands. 🌡️ According to the agency, these weather conditions are due to wind convergence and high sea surface temperatures linked to the strengthening of the El Niño phenomenon in the South American country. ⚠️ Authorities anticipate road disruptions, falling trees, and water accumulation in homes, primarily in Esmeraldas, Guayas, Santo Domingo de los Tsáchilas, Santa Elena, Los Ríos, and several other areas.

डॉ अभिषेक वर्मा, इंडियन पारा पावरलिफ्टिंग टीम सेंड -ऑफ सेरेमनी 2026 में गेस्ट ऑफ़ ऑनर एवं प्रेसाइडिंग चेयर के रूप में सम्मिलित हुए । कार्यक्रम के मुख्य अतिथि भारत में बहरीन के राजदूत महामहिम श्री अब्दुलरहमान मोहम्मद अहमद अल-गौद रहे। बहरीन में आयोजित होने वाली वर्ल्ड पारा पावरलिफ्टिंग चैंपियनशिप्स में भारत का प्रतिनिधित्व करने जा रही 25 सदस्यीय टीम को शुभकामनाएँ दीं। डॉ अभिषेक वर्मा ने अपने संबोधन में खिलाड़ियों का उत्साहवर्धन करते हुए कहा कि शारीरिक सीमाएँ कभी भी मानवीय प्रतिभा, साहस और दृढ़ संकल्प को सीमित नहीं कर सकतीं। आप सभी भारत के गौरव और करोड़ों लोगों की प्रेरणा हैं। Dr Abhishek Verma attended the Indian Para Powerlifting Team Send-Off Ceremony 2026 as the Guest of Honour and Presiding Chair. The Chief Guest at the programme was HE Mr. Abdulrahman Mohamed Ahmed Al Gaoud, Ambassador of Bahrain to India at the Leela Palace, New Delhi. He extended his best wishes to the 25-member Indian team preparing to represent the country at the World Para Powerlifting Championships in Bahrain. Addressing the gathering, Dr.Verma encouraged the athletes and said that physical limitations can never restrict human talent, courage or determination. You are the pride of India and an inspiration to millions.
